exercises.prompt: Tell us about the last time you studied in a library or another quiet place.
Some students prefer digital resources, such as e-books and websites. Others prefer printed books. Which do you prefer, and why?
A university is considering making all textbooks available only in digital format to reduce costs. What are the advantages and disadvantages?
Your local library is proposing to reduce its opening hours to save money. I am a member of the library board. Tell me what you think and convince me to agree with you.
